name: Apple Brandy Old-Fashioned

instructions.primary_message: If using sugar, place the sugar cube in the bottom of the glass and add the 2 dashes of bitters. Muddle well to blend the sugar and bitters, then add a few drops of water and stir to dissolve the sugar.
If using simple syrup, add the syrup and bitters to the glass.
Place a large chunk of ice into the glass filled with sugar and bitters and add the apple brandy. Stir well to incorporate the sugar and brandy.
Twist the lemon peel over the top, drop it into the glass and serve.

schema_metadata.keywords: apple brandy, apple cocktails, brandy, cocktail recipes, fall cocktails, holiday cocktails, holiday drinks, winter cocktails

description: An Old-Fashioned is a simple mixture of whiskey, sugar, bitters and a citrus peel. It is a sublimely simple and delicious preparation for a wide range of spirits—rum, tequila, brandy—and a fine apple brandy is no exception. This cocktail is a perfect preparation to enjoy classic holiday flavors in a new way.
notes: Optional substitutions: simple syrup → 1 sugar cube
author: Marleigh Riggins Miller
